verdict.rationale: The evidence says Requesty gives access to 300+/600+ models through one OpenAI-compatible API. Nothing in the pack documents a browsable or queryable model catalog (such as a models endpoint or models page) that exposes per-model pricing or context-window metadata. The OpenAPI spec item describes inference and management APIs generally but never mentions a model listing, so this applicable axis lacks evidence.

support.subject: As a developer, I can browse or query a catalog of available models with pricing and context-window metadata
